definitions: An act of nodding one's head.
A brief bow or inclination of the head, typically as a sign of greeting, assent, or understanding.
A signal or gesture made by nodding.
A state of being asleep or drowsy, especially when unintentional.
A slight or brief indication of acknowledgement or approval.
examples: He gave a nod of approval.
She responded with a quick nod.
He was prone to a nod after lunch.
The design was a nod to tradition.
